project-applications.title: Applications & dependencies
project-applications.overview_hint: Manage application ownership, fixed code versions and the effect of dependency changes.
project-applications.intro: An application is an independently managed delivery unit. Register its authorized code scope and inspect dependencies from an exact version.
project-applications.empty_hint: Register an application and explicitly select its team and authorized code scope. A folder name alone does not establish ownership.
project-applications.name: Application name
project-applications.path_hint: Use . for the authorized repository root. Absolute paths and parent traversal are not accepted.
project-applications.shared_hint: Overlapping code scopes require an explicit shared relationship. Team assignment does not grant repository access.
project-applications.scope_setup: Configure an authorized repository target before assigning code ownership.
project-applications.version_boundary: A registered code version fixes source evidence. It does not establish a successful build, independent test, acceptance or production deployment.
project-applications.no_sources: No eligible integrated source is available for this application.
project-applications.dependencies_hint: Dependencies are pinned to exact application versions and evidence. Unresolved observations are retained; no relation silently follows the latest version.
project-applications.no_dependencies: No dependency entries in this snapshot
project-applications.graph_hint: Read-only dependency view. Use the equivalent list to inspect every loaded relation and its source.
project-applications.impact_hint: Inspect reverse direct and transitive effects of the selected application in this dependency-graph snapshot. This view creates no task, starts no execution and approves no delivery.
project-applications.partial: Only the reported bounded scope has been analyzed.
project-applications.invalid_read: The response does not match this project, application, fixed version or original operation.
project-applications.access_changed: Access changed. Protected application details have been cleared.
project-applications.draft_guard: Keep or discard the draft before leaving this form.
project-applications.refresh_failed: Could not refresh the current basis. Your draft is retained.
project-applications.edit_hint: Keep code scope and team ownership explicit. Saving uses the reviewed record revision.
project-applications.confirm_version: I reviewed the exact integrated source and version label.
project-applications.acknowledge_gaps: I acknowledge unresolved relations, unverified constraints or incomplete observations. These gaps remain recorded.
project-applications.basis_changed: Current ownership or source basis has changed. This version retains its exact registration evidence.
project-applications.bounded_options: Options cover a bounded read. Existing references outside it remain visible by ID and need current eligibility checks before saving.
project-applications.compatibility_unkno: Version-constraint compatibility is unverified. Pinning a dependency does not prove compatibility.
project-applications.correction_hint: Record corrections in a new code version without changing the original observations. Preview the fixed source first, then select an observation or add an explicit relation.
project-applications.current_graph_hint: Nodes show each application’s current registered version. Edges retain their original pinned target version and never silently follow the latest version.
project-applications.key_hint: Start with a lowercase letter. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, up to 64 characters.
project-applications.options_incomplete: The option read reached its limit. An unloaded object must not be treated as absent.
project-applications.select_for_impact: Select an application to inspect reverse direct and transitive effects.
project-applications.graph_unavailable: Graph layout is unavailable. Use the equivalent list below.
project-applications.blocker.application: This application is archived. Restore it before registering a new code version.
The source changed. Inspect the fixed source again.
Current source quality evidence does not satisfy the requirements.
Dependency gaps remain. Review and explicitly acknowledge them.
Source observations are incomplete. Review their coverage.
The application’s code scope changed. Review it again.
project-applications.source_setup_tasks: Open project tasks to review source acceptance and manage repository integration targets
project-applications.edge.current: Pinned target is the current registered version
project-applications.edge.historical_ver: Pinned target is a historical registered version
project-applications.edge.missing_versio: Pinned version could not be verified
project-applications.blocker.application: Team ownership or application governance basis changed. Review current eligibility.
